method: label-free drift on prod hosted-decisions.jsonl; conformal-era rows only (set_size present), dogfood-replay burst excluded; first-half vs second-half split per lane; KS on confidence distributions (alpha=0.01) + route-mix PSI + auto%/set_size deltas

bank77.verdict: INPUT-MIX SHIFT — confidence dist and route mix changed between traffic batches; automation rate stable. Model decay NOT indicated (auto% flat); monitor correctly detects input drift
